create_JoinTable: create a JoinTable module that concatenates feature tensors from multiple SparseConvNetTensors along dimension 1
create_AddTable: create an AddTable module that sums feature tensors from multiple SparseConvNetTensors element-wise
create_ConcatTable: create a ConcatTable module that applies each child module to the same input and returns a list of outputs
build_JoinTable_forward: build a JoinTable and call forward with a list of SparseConvNetTensors to concatenate their features
build_ConcatTable_add: build a ConcatTable and add child modules to apply them in parallel to the same input tensor
